commits.note: the main binary was built from the branch at the PREREG commit, whose verifier sources equal main's (the PREREG commit adds one Markdown file only); the head binary from the code_change commit's sources.

binaries.discarded: a first head build started before the source edit had been saved: its build word was main's and the file was byte-identical to main's binary (cmp); it was not used for any run

hardware.cpu: AMD EPYC-Rome Processor (KVM guest), 16 vCPU, 30 GiB RAM
hardware.provider: shared agent host, loaded by other lanes during every run
hardware.pinning: taskset -c 12-15 (4 cores), every build and run behind the host's two-slot heavy-job gate

seeds_note: no randomness is drawn by any run here: the planning calls and the verifier calls on stored proofs are deterministic up to wall times (runs/compare-2/n2-touched.txt lists every line that the normalisation touched)

runs.served_form_planning: verifier/tests/served_form_test.py on prover/tests/configurations/pinned_no_proof_of_work: main test file with the main binary (runs/served/main-1.log), branch test file with the head binary (runs/served/head-1.log)
runs.stored_proofs_N: runs/compare-1 (registered normalisation N, 2 rounds per binary)
runs.stored_proofs_N2: runs/compare-2 (Amendment 1, normalisation N2, 5 rounds per binary, alternating main/head)
